item.title: Version 2.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • Set daily budgets for a whole selection at once. Select any number of campaigns and set, raise, or lower their daily budget in one step, with a preview before anything is applied. Percentage changes keep each campaign in its own currency, campaigns without a budget are skipped rather than guessed at, and large or steep changes ask first.
  • Copy keywords. Copy a single keyword or a whole selection from the keyword, negative-keyword, and search-term tables. Multiple items are copied comma-separated, ready to paste elsewhere.
  • Open a row by double-clicking anywhere on it. Double-clicking a campaign opens its ad groups, an ad group opens its keywords, and a keyword opens for editing. Previously only the name itself responded, so clicking a row’s numbers appeared to do nothing.
  • Charts scoped to what you’re looking at. Charts can now be focused on a single app, campaign, or ad group, with a scope picker and breadcrumb.

Improved

  • Revenue connects itself for apps you’ve just launched. When a new app arrives through a sync, ADSwift now tries to match it to its RevenueCat project automatically instead of waiting until you next open Settings. You can also refresh the project list on demand — previously the only way to pick up a project you’d just created was to disconnect and sign in again.
  • Your status filter is remembered. Hiding paused campaigns, ad groups, or keywords now survives a relaunch instead of resetting to All.
  • Pausing and enabling from a table row feels immediate. The row now acknowledges your click straight away and updates as soon as Apple accepts the change, instead of sitting still while it waited for a second round trip.
  • The Settings window can be resized. The Accounts tab no longer clips its list of apps.
  • Interface polish. Selected rows use a neutral highlight that belongs to the table rather than a saturated blue band; the bulk-action bar and the Adjust Bids control now match the surfaces beside them; and View Charts has moved into the overflow menu so long names have room.

Fixed

  • Revenue is never shown as zero when it isn’t actually known. If revenue can’t be fetched for an app, ADSwift now says so and retries instead of quietly displaying nothing — which was indistinguishable from an app that genuinely earned nothing, and could stick until you changed the date range. Totals no longer present a partial sum as if it were complete, ROAS and profit no longer report confident figures built on missing revenue, and CSV exports mark unavailable values rather than exporting them as zero.
  • Revenue keeps up with the date range. Switching ranges no longer leaves the previous range’s revenue on screen or blank until a manual reload.
  • Campaigns deleted in Apple Ads now disappear when you sync, together with their ad groups and keywords.
  • Deleting a campaign no longer crashes the app, whether from the table or with the detail panel open.
  • Selecting several campaigns with Command-click sticks. Adding a second row no longer cleared the whole selection a moment later, which made bulk actions unusable without a workaround.
  • Maximize Conversions campaigns are set up correctly, including the automated ad group Apple requires.
